title: Legacy+ PM Runbook
subtitle: Eversys Legacy+ | L'2c, L'2m | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: Based on the Legacy+ PM Kits Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700112914, 02.06.2026), TI-240, the e'Support history of service kit releases V3.0 (12.10.2026) and the Legacy+ brewing unit exploded view V2.0. Legacy Steam (L'2s) has no PM kit manual and is not covered. Check the Webshop configurator with the machine's serial number before ordering.

banners.text: Updated October 2026 to the Legacy+ PM Kits Manual V4.0: 24-month kits are now 36-month kits (TI-240), and the grinder kit moved from 12 to 36 months.
Legacy Steam (L'2s) is not covered: Eversys publishes no PM kit manual for it. Ask Eversys USA before ordering.
Brew module: check its part number. 115923 is medium (kit EV113692), 118839 is large (kit EV119813).
12-month PM: only 12-month kits are listed. Grinder, hydraulic, milk add-on, water pump, hot water valve block, 2 milk types and powder 36 are 36-month items.

kits.name: Grinder module Standard
kits.note: One per grinder. Grinder outlet blade 112690. Now 36 months.

kits.name: Medium brew module Standard
kits.note: Brew module M (115923). Tubes 525 mm and 350 mm.

kits.name: Large brew module Standard
kits.note: Brew module L (118839). Piston seal L-XL 116945.

kits.name: Milk module V3 Standard
kits.note: Some parts moved to EV113697 (release history V3.0).

kits.name: Milk module add-on
kits.note: Now 36 months. US shop title: 36-Month Milk PM Kit.

kits.name: Frame add-on, hot water valve block
kits.note: Now 36 months. The US shop still titles it "FRAME/TEA/24M".

items.text: Check ground-coffee total: change burrs after every 2000 kg.
Check the grinder damper: the rubber must be flexible with no cracks.
Clean the grinder at every service.
Fit EV113706 on each grinder.
Clean, then grease the shafts of the bottom arm and the top piston with JAX Pyro-plate FGN.
Check the piston screens for clogging. Clean or replace if needed.
Turn the piston screen 1/4 turn to lock it, then tighten the piston head to 8 N·m.
Cut the 525 mm and 350 mm tubes from FEP tube 101169 (1 m) or 105491 (50 m).
Fit EV113695.
Replace the 80 mm silicone hose (cut from 25 m hose 104451). Do this at every service.
Fit EV113696 (hose 104719 cut to 400 mm).
Fit EV113697.
Change the milk pipes (every 12 months). 25 m blue 106186, green 106189.
Fit EV113700 (automatic cleaning module).
Fit EV113701 (water pump) and EV113704 (hot water valve block).
Fit EV113698 and clean the 1.5-Step outlet, the fitting silicone pipe and the aerator.
Fit EV113699 (2 milk types).
Fit EV113942.
Fit EV120356.
Record the service (date, interval, kits used). Old 24-month kits may be used for the 36-month interval.

stockNote.title: 24-month kits in stock are still usable.
stockNote.text: Per TI-240 (from 1 May 2026) the 24-month kits are replaced by 36-month kits, and existing 24-month kits can be used for the 36-month interval. The grinder kit EV113706 moved from 12 to 36 months.

supersessions: Hydraulic Standard now 36 months; 112552, 112553, 112237 and 100208 removed.
Milk 12-month kit trimmed; the parts moved into the 36-month milk add-on EV113697.
112590, 112592 and 113916 moved into the new 36-month powder kit EV120356.

reference.title: Interval rule
reference.text: Under 50,000 cycles a year per group head: 12-month PM in years 1 and 2, 36-month PM in year 3, then repeat. Over 50,000: the same 12, 12, 36 pattern every 50,000 cycles. At least one PM a year is mandatory.

reference.title: Identify the model from the serial
reference.text: First 8 digits of the serial (e'Support, List of machine serial numbers - North America): L'2c 01344800, L'2m 01344900.

reference.title: Time allowance
reference.text: The Legacy+ PM manual gives no maintenance time.

reference.title: Escalation
reference.text: Eversys technical support: +41 27 588 00 17 or techsupport@eversys.com. Eversys USA: service.usa@eversys.com. Have the machine serial number and the kit number ready.
